data.title: 爱蜜莉雅 · 王选宫廷
data.description: 【爱蜜莉雅 · 王选宫廷】卢格尼卡王国庄严宏伟的王选大殿之上，爱蜜莉雅身着端庄华贵的王选正装伫立于王座之下，身旁的微精灵化作璀璨的光环流转。她挺直脊背目光清澈坚定——「我的名字叫爱蜜莉雅，只是一个普通的半精灵。但我想要创造一个所有人都能平视彼此、不再有歧视与悲伤的国家！」
data.action: 在庄严宫廷中身着礼服
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, elegant royal framing
data.promptProse: Emilia stands before the Royal Selection assembly beyond the frame, expressing her hopes with composed determination in the signature white-and-lilac dress and soft ribbon. The eye-level medium view places gilded palace columns behind her and high stained-glass windows above their receding aisle. Window light illuminates her silver hair and facing dress folds, casting tinted reflections on the nearby stone while the columns' far sides remain shaded around her dignified stance.
